这些发展牵涉的事件错综复杂，无须在此追究细节，但须注意，帝国依然有能力发动攻势。参见本书第一章对事件的综述。加上黎巴嫩马尔达人所造成的动荡，帝国发动的攻势给阿卜杜勒·马利克在北叙利亚造成了严重困难。此外，685年的和约似乎还涉及哈里发承认帝国在亚美尼亚和高加索的伊比利亚的存在，可能是因为这些地区本来就不在他控制下（名义上受他的敌人伊本·祖拜尔控制），其结果是帝国可能获得一大笔额外的贡赋。见 Kennedy 2004: 93–97；Robinson 2010: 216–217；2005: 25ff.；Hawting 1986: 46–57。关于和约、条款及其背景，见 Lilie 1976: 100–105。

The events surrounding these developments are complex and need not be pursued in detail here, but it is important to note that the empire was still in a position to mount offensive operations. See the summary of events in Chapter 1 of this volume. In conjunction with the disruption caused by the Lebanese Mardaites, this caused serious problems for ʿAbd al-Malik in North Syria. In addition, the agreement of 685 appears also to have entailed the Caliph’s acceptance of an imperial presence in Armenia and Caucasian Iberia, probably because these were areas outside his control anyway (they were nominally under that of his enemy Ibn al-Zubayr), with the possibility of a substantial additional tributary income falling to the empire as a consequence. See Kennedy 2004: 93–97; Robinson 2010: 216–217; 2005: 25ff.; Hawting 1986: 46–57. For the treaties and their terms and context: Lilie 1976: 100–105.

学界对确切起因意见不一。狄奥凡尼斯沿用他的史料，称是皇帝之过，因为他把塞浦路斯居民迁去了基齐库斯，又因691年所交贡金用的是新铸的伊斯兰货币，上面没有十字架或明显的基督教象征，便拒收了贡金（见 Theoph., 365；Mango and Scott 509）。讨论见 Lilie 1976: 106–110。关于货币问题，见 Treadwell 2012（附有早期研究和年代次序的详细讨论）、Robinson 2010: 220、Kennedy 2004: 98–99。粗看之下，查士丁尼实际拒绝收下贡金的可能性不大，约365,000枚金币相当于当时帝国年财政收入的很大一部分。

Historians disagree over the exact causes. Theophanes, following his source, claims it was the emperor’s fault for moving the population of Cyprus to Kyzikos, and for refusing to accept the tribute for 691 because it was delivered in the form of a newly minted Islamic coinage with no cross or obvious Christian symbolism (see Theoph., 365; Mango and Scott 509); discussion in Lilie 1976: 106–110, and on the coinage issue: Treadwell 2012 (with earlier literature and detailed discussion of the chronology); Robinson 2010: 220; Kennedy 2004: 98–99. It is on the face of it unlikely that Justinian in fact rejected the tribute— a sum of some 365,000 gold coins would represent a substantial percentage of the surviving annual imperial fiscal revenue.

上一章谈到了地区、地方和文化差异，须把这些差异考虑在内。但有一点非常清楚：教会在国家支持下代表了一个象征宇宙，在这个宇宙中，一套基督教的罗马政治神学为东罗马向内向外施加并维持其权力提供了正当性，也促进了这一过程。在正式的官方文献里，罗马人仍是选民，罗马帝国则是上帝在地上的王国。正如五六会议致查士丁尼二世的开幕文辞所说，由上帝所选立的统治者治理的罗马国家，乃是神圣之国、特选之民。五六会议的教规坚持各地须与君士坦丁堡的教会保持一致，从中可以看出教会在这方面的自觉。
在这里，拜占庭帝国教会的秩序与纪律被列为整个基督徒共同体的标准，东方和西方都应遵从。拜占庭教会由此体现了正统皇帝所代表的政治
oikoumene

iussio
（敕令），又如680—681年在君士坦丁堡召开第六次普世教会会议时，收入其会议记录的帝国致教廷书信。

With all the caveats about regional, local, and cultural variation that we have discussed in the preceding chapter, it is nevertheless very clear that the church, supported by the state, represented a symbolic universe within which a Christian Roman political theology legitimated and promoted the projection and maintenance of east Roman power, both internally and externally. In formal and official texts, the Romans remained the Chosen People and the Roman Empire was God’s kingdom on earth. As the prefaratory address of the Quinisext to Justinian II puts it, the Roman state under its God-appointed ruler is the Holy Nation, the Special People; and in the canons of the Quinisext and their insistence on conformity with the Constantinopolitan church we can detect a self-awareness in this respect.

Here we see a presentation of the order and discipline of the Byzantine imperial church as the standard for the whole Christian community, Eastern and Western, in which the Byzantine church reflected the political
oikoumene

represented by the orthodox emperor. Of course, military coercive power, the ability to tax and extract resources in manpower and agricultural, pastoral or mineral produce (with the underlying threat of coercion to reinforce it), and the ability to defend and maintain its frontiers played an equally fundamental role. But in terms of beliefs, motives, and the rationale of empire, imperial orthodoxy— however contested within the bounds of empire and however defined and refined in theological discourse and conflict across the years— was a
sine qua non
for Roman identity and presentation of self to the outside world, evident in such official proclamations of imperial orthodoxy as Justinian II’s
iussio
of 687, or the imperial letters to the papacy included in the acts of the sixth ecumenical council at Constantinople in 680–681.

and

这套更广泛的信念为理解东罗马国家的政治神学提供了观念框架。政治神学本身又以两套规范为支撑，它们将一系列价值观纳入特定的制度安排。在东罗马国家保有的疆域内，这些制度促成了一个跨越地域和社会分野、带有鲜明罗马帝国性质的利益共同体，尽管人们未必形成了自觉的共同认同。这两套规范，一是继续沿用的罗马法，二是教会的教会法。也许更重要的是，世俗与教会的领域在法律和规章上越来越趋同。近来的研究着重指出了这种现象，确是有道理的。
罗马法是国家运作的关键要素，与教会、财政制度和军队一样，是国家得以作为主导的政治结构发挥作用的工具之一。立法是皇帝的特权，因此法律及其相关的一切也象征着罗马帝国国家。事实上，正确信仰即正统，是维持上帝支持的基本要素。对由上帝选立的罗马皇帝所确定的法律和正义予以适当尊重，同样如此：

These are the continuing application of Roman law, on the one hand, and the canon law of the church. Perhaps more significantly, there also took place an ever-greater convergence of the secular and ecclesiastical realms in law and regulation, a phenomenon that has recently and rightly been highlighted and underlined.

Roman law was a crucial element in the way the state functioned, and it represented, along with the church, the fiscal system and the military, one of the instruments through which the state as the dominant political structure could operate. Law-making was the prerogative of the emperor, and the law and all that was associated with it thus also symbolized the imperial Roman state. 它从基督教的视角得到诠释，适用时逐案判断，地区之间的差异很大，有时还因地方习惯和传统的存续而受到削弱，尤其是涉及亲属关系、继承或惩罚各类刑事犯罪时。即便如此，它还是深入了拜占庭社会的基层。
《法律选编》
序言非常清楚地说明了这些目标：
It is true that the pattern of imperial legislative activity changes radically from the early decades of the seventh century. No longer do emperors legislate through edicts and
novellae constitutiones
as had emperors before Heraclius. Instead the business of the state is regulated through imperial orders or commands—
iussiones
or
keleuseis

— that dealt with immediate issues, while the legal and moral framework established by Justinian’s codification in the sixth century was taken as the norm to which government, church, and people should conform. Indeed, the sort of legal activity pursued by the emperors of the sixth century became both impractical, in light of the difficult conditions of the times, and ideologically redundant. Imperial commands and orders— legislation in the broadest sense— were aimed at rectifying a situation and restoring the norms of the (lost) Justinianic moral and administrative universe. The
Ecloga

, the slimmed down codification of Justinianic law issued by the emperors Leo III and Constantine V in 741, aimed specifically to make the Justinianic code more accessible and usable, and the changes it introduced were not understood as novelties but rather as reaffirming and reinforcing the moral universe of the older laws.

Interpreted through a Christian lens, applied casuistically, regionally very variable in its application and diluted in some cases by the persistence of local custom and tradition, especially where issues of kinship, inheritance, or the punishment of various criminal offenses was concerned, it nevertheless penetrated to the roots of Byzantine society.
The preface of the
Ecloga
sets out the aims very clearly:

……我们知道，先帝颁布的法律载于多卷书册，对一部分人而言，其所含义理难解，对另一些人而言，尤其那些居住在我们这座上帝护佑的帝都以外的人，其中的意思全然难以领会。因此，我们在诸位最显赫的贵族、最显赫的法务官、最显赫的执政官与秘书，以及其他敬畏上帝者的协助下，下令把所有这些书集中呈于我们面前。我们详审了所有这些卷帙，既取上述书卷中表述妥当之处，也取我们自己在新法中所定的条文，认为宜在本书中将常见的裁断、契约事项以及犯罪的刑罚，表述得更清楚简要，旨在让人更易了解这些虔敬法律的义理，使诉讼更易裁决，使作恶者受到公正的惩罚，并使有犯罪倾向的人知所戒惧、改正行为。

. . . recognizing that the laws issued by our imperial predecessors are written down in many volumes, and knowing that for some the meaning contained within them is difficult while for others it is completely inaccessible, indeed especially for those who dwell outside this, our God-protected imperial city, we have, therefore, with the collaboration of our most glorious patrikioi, of the most glorious quaestor, and of the most glorious consuls and secretaries and other God-fearing persons, ordained that all those books should be assembled in our presence. And after a thoroughgoing examination of all these tomes, and making use both of what is well-expressed in the aforementioned volumes as well as of that which we have ourselves decreed in new laws, we have held it appropriate to set out more clearly and more concisely in the present book those decisions and contractual matters that arise frequently, as well as the punishments for offences, with the aim of offering a more manageable understanding of the sense of these pious laws, easier decisions for legal cases, the just punishment of evildoers and the discouragement and correction of those who tend to sin.
立法和管理国家，仍是统治者切身关心的要务。
事实上，若无法维持既有的法律框架，政府和精英就都无法保持对行省居民的控制。虽说法律在各行省的施行不均，帝国行政当局仍借由它来施行司法，既以此强化基督徒（罗马人）的认同，也借此推行在社会中行之有效的一套共同的财产与继承规范。
法律的存在反映也象征着东罗马国家凭其制度网络惊人地深入社会最底层，触及家庭、家长的权利、动产及不动产的处分方式、男女子女的权利，以及夫妻、姻亲与父母的权利和义务。
Legislation and managing the state remained crucial interests of the ruler;

indeed, without the maintenance of the established framework of the law, neither government nor elite would have been able to maintain their control of the provincial populations. While its application was patchy in the provinces, it was the instrument through which the imperial administration dealt out justice and it served both as a means of reinforcing Christian (Roman) identity as well as of imposing a common set of socially effective norms in respect of property and inheritance.

Its existence reflected and symbolized the remarkable infrastructural reach of the eastern Roman state into the lowest levels of society, affecting the family; the rights of the head of a household; the ways in which property, both movable and immovable, was to be disposed; the rights of children, male and female; and the rights and duties of husbands and wives, in-laws and parents.

序言指出，颁布这部法典的一个主要原因，是行省司法状况令人震惊，人们不懂法学文献，受托担任司法职务的人腐败，而有权有钱者又能施加影响。
然而，法典的正文提到了行省的法庭和法官。一点零星证据表明，尽管时局削弱了司法实践和体制，它们仍在行省延续。皇帝又说，他们希望颁行法典能让帝国立法在各行省普遍恢复效力。这表明，传统民政体系的大部分已经受到了侵蚀。

noted as one major reason for its promulgation the shocking state of jurisprudence in the provinces, the ignorance of legal literature, the corruption of those entrusted with judicial office, and the influence of the powerful and wealthy.

Yet provincial courts and judges are mentioned in the body of the text, and a little incidental evidence suggests that justice and the judicial framework, however attenuated by circumstances, continued to maintain a provincial existence, even though the emperors go on to hope that their code would facilitate a general rehabilitation of imperial legislation in the provinces, suggestive of the erosion of much of the traditional fabric of civil administration.

(Nomos geōrgikos),
closely associated with the
Ecloga,

deals with a specific and very limited field of interest, namely property relations within a rural community. While the precise date of its compilation remains debated, it is generally agreed that it was produced at some point between the middle of the seventh and the early ninth century, and more likely was associated from the start with texts such as the
Ecloga.

Given its structure and content, which are neither antiquarian nor reflective of a classicizing compilation for the purposes of jurisprudential study, its very existence demonstrates a perceived need for a formal regulatory procedure that would deal with issues of property law, land-use, tenurial rights and obligations, trespass, livestock, theft, and a host of related issues. This in turn implies very strongly the direct intervention of the state in the form of local magistrates, and since some of the provisions of the
Nomos geōorgikos

Roman law continued to embody the empire and imperial rule in the provinces; it was as much an aspect of imperial administration and surveillance as it was a legal system in any modern sense. And while it is likely that the numbers of individuals who actually came into formal contact with it was very limited, we should also bear in mind that, as the legislation of the emperor Justinian in the sixth century makes quite clear, the presence in Constantinople of ordinary subjects, such as peasant farmers, among many others who had come to seek justice in imperial courts, was entirely usual— indeed, was a problem in terms of increasing the city’s population, even if temporarily.

Such a tradition was not readily forgotten; appeal to imperial justice in the capital, however difficult of access for most, would certainly have reinforced ties between metropolis and provinces; and the existence of the Farmers Law at the very least indicates that for most an awareness of “the law” at some level or other was entirely standard.

Roman law in the eastern empire after the sixth century was increasingly affected, both in terms of practice and interpretation, by the growing moral authority of the church. Indeed, in the context I have described, the church and its clergy were likely at least as important, and probably more important, in daily life than the civil law or the judicial apparatus, along with the fiscal officers and the local military who must have represented for a substantial part of the provincial population their major contact with the state and the representatives of the established order. This brings us to the second key element, canon law, the law of the church.
In the
Ecloga

in particular, the close association between justice and Christian philanthropy has long been recognized, along with what has been termed a “scriptural turn” in both the language of the law as well as in respect of some of the sanctions outlined.

While it is the case that there had always been an association between the secular and the sacred in the Roman world, even before Christianity (indeed, in all ancient cultures), the affinity between the canons of the Quinisext council in 691/692 and the language and moral universe of the
Ecloga

is clear, and indicates the increasing formal convergence we have noted already between these two spheres— a convergence that meant for contemporaries the effective blending of church with state, conceptually if not necessarily in daily practical respects.

The close relationship between secular and spiritual authority was of particular importance for it was, of course, only through the armed might of the state that the orthodoxy of the day could be properly and effectively enforced or defended, at least within the empire’s borders.
So it was in those areas of social and moral life where state and church met that the effectiveness of a Christian and Roman identity was determined and reinforced.

From the time of the emperor Justinian in the sixth century, canon law— the moral and disciplinary code of the church— had been endowed with the force of the law of the state. The evolving relationship between church and state is summed up in the introduction to Justinian’s sixth
novella constitutio,
issued in the year 535:
人类所获的至大福分，是上帝以天上慈悲赐予我们的恩惠，即司祭职与皇权。司祭职侍奉神圣之事，皇权统辖人间事务并勤于治理，但二者同出一个源头……所以，没有什么比教士的尊严与荣誉更值得皇帝关切……因为，如果司祭职各方面都无可指摘……如果皇权以正当而合宜的方式使受托治理的共同体臻于美善，那么必有福祉与和谐，给人类带来一切善事。

The greatest blessings of mankind are the gifts of God which have been granted us by the mercy on high— the priesthood and the imperial authority. The priesthood ministers to things divine; the imperial authority is set over, and shows diligence in, things human; but both proceed from one and the same source. . . Nothing, therefore, will be a greater matter of concern to the emperor than the dignity and honor of the clergy. . . For if the priesthood be in all respects without blame. . . and if the imperial authority rightly and duly adorn the commonwealth committed to its charge, there will ensue a happy concord which will bring forth all good things for mankind.
620年代编成了一部特别重要的法典，即通常所说的
《十四题法典》
（Nomokanon in fourteen titles）。它以一系列主题为题目，将有关世俗民法和教会法的所有主要法令集成一书，进一步加强了这种关系。
它的一个作用，是使世俗当局能依据基督教的道德宇宙作出法律裁决。
另一个作用，是将特有的基督教立场引入家庭和人际关系，其中包括削减
家父
（paterfamilias）的权力，增加妇女在继承和掌控自己财产方面的选择，限制离婚的可能性，规定婚姻中血亲关系的亲等（因而直接影响继承与财产处分的方式）。也许最重要的是，它表明皇帝的职责虽包括保护教会和推行教会法，皇帝本人却也同自己的臣民一样，必须遵从完全相同的道德规范。
这些发展进一步加强，可以说在691/692年于君士坦丁堡召开的五六会议的教规中达到了顶点。
查士丁尼二世亲自出席了这次会议，把自己表述为上帝与人类之间居中传达权威的人，是引领基督徒会众的牧人。会议事实上将教会法作为国家立法的一部分来用。
查士丁尼二世在687年给教皇写信确认680—681年会议的决议。这封信、691/692年会议的开幕文辞，以及
《法律选编》
的序言，都表明皇帝既是上帝选立和指引的统治者，也是蒙上帝护佑、引领并保卫基督徒会众的牧人。致查士丁尼二世的开幕文辞这样说：
In the 620s a particularly important codification, the so-called
Nomokanon in fourteen titles,
assembled in a single work under a series of thematic titles all the key legislation concerning both secular civil law and canon law, reinforcing this relationship.
One of the effects of this was to permit secular authorities to invoke a Christian moral universe in arriving at legal decisions;
another was to introduce a particularly Christian approach to the family and personal social relationships, entailing a reduction in the power of the
paterfamilias,

increasing the range of options open to women in respect of inheritance and control over their own property, limiting the possibilities for divorce, determining degrees of consanguinity in marital relationships (and thus directly impacting on patterns of inheritance and the disposition of property), and, perhaps most significantly, making it clear that while the duties of the ruler included the protection of the church and the implementation of its laws, emperors were subject to exactly the same moral code as their subjects.
These developments were intensified and can be said to have culminated in the canons of the Quinisext council held in Constantinople in 691/692,

a council that Justinian II attended and where he presented himself as the mediating authority between God and humankind, as the shepherd who guides the Christian flock, and in which canon law was effectively deployed as an aspect of the legislation of the state.
Justinian II’s letter to the pope in 687 confirming the decisions of the council of 680–681, the opening address of the council of 691/692, and the preface to the
Ecloga

all imply an emperor who was both the divinely appointed and divinely guided ruler as well as the shepherd and defender of the Christian flock under God’s divine protection. The opening address to Justinian II put it thus:
基督我们的上帝，掌着这艘最大的船，即整个世界的舵，如今立您在我们之上。您是明智的统领、虔敬的皇帝，实为我们的保护者。您出言明辨，永远守护真理，在大地上施行审判与正义，行在无可指摘的道路上。智慧怀您于腹，以美德将您养育。她抚养您，教导您，使您充满上帝的灵。她使您成为整个世界的眼睛，您以心智的纯洁与光辉照亮您的臣民。她把自己的教会托付给您，教您昼夜默想她的律法，以纠正、教化您的臣民。

Christ our God, who steers this greatest of ships, the entire world, has now set you over us, the wise governor, the pious emperor, our protector indeed: you who dispense your words in discernment safeguard truth always, render judgement and justice upon earth and walk in the blameless path. Wisdom bore you in her womb and nurtured you well with virtues; she brought you up and educated you and filled you with the Spirit of God; she has made you the eye of the universe, you who brightly illumine your subjects with the pureness and splendor of your mind. To you she has entrusted her Church and has taught you to meditate on her law day and night, for the correction and edification of the peoples subject to you.
文辞又说：“因此，我们遵您之命，齐聚于这座上帝守护的帝都，拟订了这些神圣的教规。所以……您既用召集会议的书信尊崇了教会，愿您最终也以虔敬的签署确认我们的决议。”
在某种意义上，691/692年会议的教规架起了一座桥，联结了查士丁尼法典与
《法律选编》
。在这一过程中，基督徒罗马皇帝自己也被纳入以救赎为目的的基督教历史进程，成为《旧约》先知的继承者。这些发展并非从未中断，
《法律选编》
也反映出利奥三世对在位时所面临的形势采取了有些不同的应对，但其总体方向一目了然。

And again: “For this reason, then, we have assembled at your command in this God-guarded imperial city, and have drawn up these sacred canons. Wherefore. . . even as you have honored the Church with your letters of convocation, so may you finally confirm our resolutions through your pious signature.”
In some respect the canons of the council of 691/692 represent the bridge between the Justinianic corpus and the
Ecloga,

in which the Christian Roman emperors themselves were incorporated into the soteriological teleology of Christian history as heirs of the Old Testament prophets. While these developments were not uninterrupted, and while the
Ecloga
reflects a somewhat different reaction to the situation with which Leo III had to contend during his reign, their overall direction cannot be mistaken.

世俗法与宗教法的密切结合，使国家的权威进一步深入基层，也使帝国教会在最底层的村庄社会中，成为构成和强化拜占庭人关于帝国及其统治之观念的一个关键因素。接下来几个世纪里，这些变化的走向越来越清楚。与中世纪西方不同，东罗马始终没有形成一个专门研习教会法的法学家阶层，反而由教会公职人员兼理世俗司法。教士既谙熟教会法，又精通民法。最终，拜占庭教会的教会法完全吸纳了民法传统，没有沿着一条与民法分立的道路发展。
这一基督教象征宇宙固然以不同方式影响社会各个层次及其社会实践，但种种变化之下是一条共同的信息：东罗马帝国是上帝在地上的帝国，其统治者由上帝选立。正如当时的启示文学及末世论作品（以及后来的传统）所体现的，
其命运是收复罗马“失地”、传播正统，并战胜不信者及挑战皇帝统治的人。鉴于上述情形，毋庸置疑，这一信息深入了社会基层。但是，这类信念在多大程度上产生了共同认同，在多大程度上使有文化者和有特权者以外的人也能在观念上同心行动，无论是就日常生活而言，还是就国家调动人力物力的方式而言，仍不清楚。

The close association between secular and religious law thus intensified the penetrative authority of the state while at the same time strengthening the role of the imperial church as a key reinforcing and structuring element in Byzantine notions of empire and imperial rule at the humblest level of village society. The direction these developments took was to become clearer over the following centuries. Not only did there never develop a specialist class of canon lawyers in the eastern Roman context, unlike in the medieval West, but ecclesiastical office-holders functioned also in secular justice. Churchmen acquired proficiency in civil as well as canon law, with the ultimate result that the canon law of the Byzantine church entirely subsumed the civil law tradition, rather than evolving along its own separate course.

While the ways in which this Christian symbolic universe inflected different levels of society and social praxis certainly varied, underlying such variations was a single message: the Eastern Roman Empire was God’s empire on earth, its ruler appointed by God, and its destiny—as reflected in the apocalyptic and eschatological literature of the times (as well as in later tradition)

— was both to recover “lost” Roman territory and to extend orthodoxy, and to overcome the faithless and those who challenged the rule of the emperor. That it reached deep into society is not in doubt, in light of these considerations. But the extent to which such beliefs generated a shared identity, to what extent they promoted a unity of ideological purpose in terms of social action beyond the level of the literate and the privileged— whether in respect of day- to-day life or in respect of the ways in which the state could mobilize resources in manpower and materials— still remains unclear.
在这方面，五六会议的教规是重要的史料，尤其能说明问题。教规涉及教士纪律和教会在共同体中的日常活动，所涉主题非常广泛。会议谴责四处云游的隐士和修道士，认为应把他们驱逐出去，或带入有纪律约束的修道院。教规重申了对占卜、预言、交感巫术、护符和咒语的谴责。教会认为，这些行为和做法给人提供了另一种求取神的指引和救助的途径，因而挑战了教会既有的灵性权威：“至于那些所谓的
eremitai
，穿黑衣、蓄长发，在各城游走，同男女混在一起，玷辱了自己的修道志业，我们规定，如果他们愿意剪发，穿上其他修道士所穿的会衣，就当将他们安置在修道院中。如果他们不愿这样做，就当把他们彻底逐出城市，让他们住在旷野，他们自造的称号便是从那里来的。”

The canons of the Quinisext are an important source in this context and are especially revealing. Dealing with a wide range of topics connected with clerical discipline and the day- to-day presence of the church in the community, they range widely in their subject matter. Wandering hermits and monks are condemned and should be either driven out or taken into the disciplined environment of a monastery. Condemnations of fortune-telling and prophecy and the use of sympathetic magic, amulets, and charms were likewise repeated, such behavior and practices being seen by the church as a challenge to its established spiritual authority, offering as they did an alternative means of access to divine guidance and succor: “Regarding the so-called
eremitai

who go about the cities clad in black and with long hair, associating with men and women and making a mockery of their calling, we decree that, if they choose to have their haircut and to assume the habit of the other monks, they should be placed in a monastery; but if they choose not to do this, they should be driven from the cities altogether and dwell in the wilderness, from whence they fabricated their appellation.”
如前所述，圣徒传、奇迹集和
《问答录》
一类著作也表达了类似的关切。一部七世纪文集中的一个问题指出，能行奇迹的并非只有“真正的”圣者，术士和巫师也能行奇迹。即便事情有某种神意在其中起作用，能行奇迹也不保证一个人有圣德。
教规往往重申较早会议汇编里的条文，不过也会时而增订新教规以应对新问题。另一条重申的教规提到，许多教士逃离受“蛮族”袭扰威胁的地区，这让人无法确定这些规定到底能落实到什么程度。
教会当局关心人们通过什么途径接触神圣权威，并把它对神的意志如何使事情发生的忧虑，转化为立法规定这些途径怎样运作、由谁控制。
关于云游隐士的教规便是一例。正式的宗教与世俗权力机构距离相对遥远，民众需要的是更近便、更具体的灵性指引。这一点一直令当局担心。
但七世纪后半叶的特殊形势，让既有的或正在形成的实践与信仰，有了与较平稳年代迥异的力量和作用。
As I have already pointed out, similar concerns are expressed in hagiographies, miracle collections, and the
Questions and Answers

literature. And one question in a seventh-century collection notes that it is not just “true” holy men who can work miracles: sorcerers and magicians are also at work— indeed, the ability to work miracles is no guarantee of sanctity, even if a divine purpose is somehow at work.

While often repeated from earlier conciliar collections, new canons were from time to time added to address new problems, even if the flight of many of the clergy from areas threatened by “barbarian” raids— mentioned in another repeated canon— leaves us unsure as to the extent to which their prescriptions could be implemented.
The established church was concerned about channels of access to divine authority, and it redirected its anxiety about divine causation into legislating how that access worked and who controlled it.

The canon on wandering hermits is a case in point. People needed local and more tangible forms of spiritual guidance than those offered by the relatively distant institutions of formal religious or secular authorities, and the authorities were always worried about this.

But the peculiar context of the later seventh century lends to both well-established practices and beliefs and to those that were in process of evolving, a very different force and effect from that which they had possessed in less troubled times.

五六会议教规的主要议题，是教会权威以及教士与平信徒都应遵守的正确基督教礼仪。然而，要紧的是，以教规在这里的形式和出台的背景，实际上也应把它们当作帝国法律来理解。如刚才所见，无论在致皇帝的开幕文辞还是在会议的第一条教规里，会议都断然驳斥了马克西姆及其追随者的看法对皇帝在教会中的权威提出的挑战。在后面的一条教规里，会议也同样明确地重申了在礼仪中为皇帝保留的特殊地位。在许多方面，这些教规标志着世俗与教会的权威在观念上汇归于上帝选立、爱基督的皇帝之下的最后阶段。这本是一个漫长过程，始于四世纪在基督教基础上对皇帝的“再神圣化”。
但七世纪后半叶，这一过程进入了又一个阶段：与世俗权威相关的诸种制度逐渐被纳入一个蒙上帝护佑、由上帝命定、由上帝所选的统治者领掌的体系。

The canons of the Quinisext are dominated by issues connected with the question of ecclesiastical authority and correct Christian observance among both clergy and laity. But the key point remains that in the form and context in which they are framed here, they are in effect to be understood also as imperial law. As we have just seen, in the introductory address to the emperor, as well as in the very first canon of the council, they decisively reject the challenge to imperial authority in the church presented by the views of Maximus and his followers, while in a later canon they equally decisively reaffirm the especially privileged place reserved to the emperor in the liturgy. They mark in many respects the final stage in the conceptual merging of secular and ecclesiastical authority under the God-appointed and Christ-loving emperor, itself a long, drawn-out process that had begun in the fourth century with a Christian “resacralization” of the emperor.

But the later seventh century saw a further stage in this process: a progressive assimilation of the institutions associated with the secular authority into a God-protected and divinely ordained structure headed by the ruler chosen by God.
这一发展中有一个至关重要、却常被忽视或视为当然的事实。在君士坦丁堡，皇帝和牧首共享同一个实际空间和观念空间。罗马城的教皇从五世纪后期起，却不再有地位相当的世俗对等者。
在君士坦丁堡，两种权力因此产生了紧张关系，有时也发生争执。但更重要的是，在这一时期乃至八世纪后期，皇权通常远在牧首的权威之上，只有少数例外。例如，一直到了拜占庭中期，皇帝仍为自己和继承人加冕，牧首则在场见证，以担保皇帝恪守正统。

Of fundamental importance in this development was the often overlooked or taken for granted fact that, in Constantinople, both emperor and patriarch shared the same conceptual as well as physical space, whereas in the city of Rome itself from the later fifth century the popes had no secular counterpart of equivalent status.

In Constantinople this led to tension as well as to occasional disagreement between these two powers. But it also meant more significantly that imperial authority tended, with only occasional exceptions in this period (and into the later eighth century), to far outweigh patriarchal authority— emperors continued to crown both themselves and their successors well into the middle Byzantine period, for example, with the patriarch in attendance as a witness and guarantor of imperial orthodoxy.
相比之下，五世纪以后，在西方既无帝国宫廷，也没有强大的帝国实际控制力，
唯有教廷代表教会，而且身处的是多个相互竞争的“继承”政体并存的国际环境，而非一个统一的政治实体。罗马教廷取得自主的速度及自主权的程度，往往被夸大，但七世纪后半叶的政治现实，确实给了教皇比君士坦丁堡牧首更大的回旋余地和自主性。

当然，帝国权威还通过总督区和众多延续至七世纪后半叶及八世纪初的军事指挥机构而继续存在。帝国权威在象征层面始终在场，体现于典礼，也体现于这样的假定，即皇帝继续对罗马及其领土乃至教皇本人拥有权威。例如，教皇的任命由皇帝直接批准，685年之后则由拉文纳的总督批准；而意大利教皇领地所缴的税一直解往君士坦丁堡，直到君士坦丁四世在位时为止。帝国权威有时也实实在在地出现，例如663年君士坦斯二世来到罗马。但实际处理日常事务时，教皇还得靠自己，尽管有帝国这一背景，偶尔也有帝国提供军事与财政援助。
还应记住，与东方很不相同，西方没有别的使徒教座。自君士坦丁建立新都不久，有使徒渊源的安条克这类城市就一直与没有使徒渊源的君士坦丁堡竞争。君士坦丁堡教座作为一种教会权威，受皇权的影响更大，这也是罗马及教皇取得首位地位的另一个因素。
In the west after the fifth century, in contrast, and in the absence of both an imperial court and a strong imperial presence,

the papacy alone represented the church, and in an international context of competing “successor” polities rather than within a single political formation. While the pace and nature of papal autonomy at Rome has often been exaggerated, the political realities of the later seventh century did endow the popes, in comparison with the patriarchs at Constantinople, with a greater degree of leeway and autonomy.

Imperial authority was, of course, present in the form of the exarchate and the various military commands that survived into the later seventh and early eighth century. Its symbolic presence was a constant, reflected through ceremonial, through the assumption that the emperor continued to wield authority over Rome and its territory as well as over the popes themselves (in terms of ratifying papal appointments, for example, either directly or, after 685, through the exarchs in Ravenna), and through the forwarding of taxes raised on papal properties in Italy to Constantinople (until the reign of Constantine IV). Occasionally it was physically present, as with the arrival of Constans II in 663. But in terms of practical, day- to-day realities, the popes had to fend for themselves, regardless of this imperial backdrop and the occasional infusions of imperial military and financial support.

And we should also recall that in the west, in strong contrast with the east, there was no other apostolic see. From the early days of the foundation of Constantine’s new capital, there had always been competition between a city like Antioch, which was apostolic, and Constantinople, which was not. The greater weight of imperial influence on the see of Constantinople as an ecclesiastical authority was yet another factor in the emergence of Rome and of papal primacy.
不过，这些变化也不宜夸大。例如，哪怕忏悔者马克西姆，也不肯主张罗马教座拥有绝对的首位权。罗马和君士坦丁堡一样受制于历史情势，教皇也有出错的时候。双方的争议也并非以“西方”和“东方”来加以界定或理解。不过，按一篇支持马克西姆的记述，655年他遭帝国高官审讯时，确有人以“罗马人”与“希腊人”来简称教皇与皇帝各自的立场。据该文献，
sakellarios
（国库长官）问：“你为什么爱罗马人而恨希腊人？”
在马克西姆看来，最终的权威来自教父与教会会议，而不来自某个个人。他没有把罗马教会本身（或教廷）同罗马人的整个教会区分开来。倘若教廷接受帝国的立场，马克西姆和他的盟友也会同样严厉地谴责它。教皇霍诺里乌斯在位时确实接受了帝国立场，后来维塔利安在位时也曾默认了短暂的一段时间。
然而，640年代及之后的政治和文化形势，特别是忏悔者马克西姆及其盟友对一志论提出的挑战，无疑使牧首与教皇各自迥异的处境、罗马与君士坦丁堡在政治和意识形态上日益扩大的距离，更加突出了。尽管在七世纪余下的几十年间，双方都作出过妥协，仍是如此。
这一形势使罗马教廷在处理地区政治和宗教事务时，有了务实而独立行动的空间，也使它越来越公开地主张罗马在神学上的首位权与教会的独立性。这一形势也加强了罗马、北非与西西里之间原已密切的联系，因为东方的亚历山大里亚、耶路撒冷和安条克诸牧首辖区，只能从旁观望。亚历山大里亚始终认同帝国立场，耶路撒冷也在信奉一志论的约帕的塞尔吉乌斯管辖下，安条克教座当时则空缺。

We should not exaggerate these developments. We should remember, for example, that not even Maximus the Confessor was prepared to claim absolute primacy for the Roman see, conditioned as it was— like Constantinople—by historical circumstances in which popes were just as fallible. Nor were disagreements framed or conceptualized in terms of “west” and “east,” even if, according to the pro-Maximus account of his interrogation at the hands of high-ranking imperial officials in 655, a distinction between “Romans” and “Greeks” was employed as a shorthand for the papal and imperial positions. As the text has it, the
sakellarios
(chief treasurer) asks, “Why do you love the Romans and hate the Greeks?”

Final authority derived, in Maximus’s view, through the Fathers of the church and the councils rather than through an individual, and he does not separate out the Roman church as such (or the papacy) from the church of the Romans in general. Had the papacy accepted the imperial position— which under Pope Honorius and later, if tacitly and briefly under Pope Vitalian, it did— then Maximus and his allies would have condemned it just as roundly.

Yet there is little doubt that the political and cultural situation of the 640s and after, and in particular the antimonothelete challenge mounted by Maximus the Confessor and his allies, gave further emphasis to the very different situations of patriarch and pope as well as to the growing political and ideological distance between Rome and Constantinople (regardless of the compromises made by both parties across the remaining decades of the century).

It promoted in Rome the space for pragmatic and independent action in respect of papal handling of regional political and religious matters as well as an increasingly vocal assertion of Roman theological primacy and ecclesiastical independence. It also strengthened the already close ties between Rome, North Africa, and Sicily, given the inability of the eastern patriarchates of Alexandria, Jerusalem, or Antioch to do more than observe from the sidelines: Alexandria remained loyal to the imperial position; Jerusalem was likewise under the authority of the monothelete Sergius of Joppa; and the see of Antioch was vacant at the time.
妥协一旦失败，政府便以放逐和监禁来隔离反对一志论的声音。结果，帝国对君士坦丁堡教座内部教会事务和神学问题的监管加强了。后来与教廷正式和解成为必要时，先是在君士坦丁四世及其顾问的领导下，随后又在查士丁尼二世治下，灵性和世俗权威实际上被表述为统一在帝国正统之下的制度。680—681年会议致君士坦丁四世的
prosphōnētikos logos
（致辞）、查士丁尼687年的
iussio
（敕令）、五六会议教规及
《法律选编》
都可以看到这一点。政治形势固然使这种举措有了必要性，但值得注意的是，在这方面采取主动的是皇帝，教皇和牧首都没有发起这一举措。

The government response to the antimonothelete challenge was, once compromise had failed, to isolate oppositional voices through banishment and imprisonment, with the result that imperial oversight of ecclesiastical and theological matters within the see of Constantinople was intensified. When formal reconciliation with the papacy became necessary, first under Constantine IV and his advisors and later under Justinian II, spiritual and secular authority were presented in effect as a single, unified institution under the banner of imperial orthodoxy, as we can see in the
prosphōnētikos logos
addressed by the council of 680– 681 to Constantine IV as well as in Justinian’s
iussio
of 687, in the canons of the Quinisext, and in the
Ecloga.
Indeed, while the political situation certainly warranted the move, it is perhaps significant that it was the emperor, not the pope or the patriarch, who took the initiative in this respect.
皇帝崇拜的基督教化在五世纪完成，其全部含义与影响经过数十年才显现。
从一开始，人们就普遍认定，皇帝同时代表世俗与灵性两种权威。瓦伦提尼安二世在384年颁行的一条法律反映了这种趋势：“对皇帝的裁断，不得有任何异议。怀疑皇帝选中的人是否称职，乃是某种亵渎。”如何使两种权威协调，是帝国立场的核心。查士丁尼在535年颁行的第六号新律概括了这一立场，尽管围绕这一主题，尤其是围绕皇帝在制定教义一事上的作用，仍有紧张和争论。
这个过程的重心在帝国宫廷和统治者的地位。查士丁尼及其继承者的立法和教会政策，以及前面已经提到、现在已较为人所理解的朝廷和宫廷典礼的礼仪化，标示了这个过程的各个阶段。
从四世纪到七世纪及以后，人们欢呼皇帝是“新君士坦丁”“新查士丁尼”，意在唤起这种传统。“新所罗门”或“新大卫”则唤起基督徒罗马皇帝在《圣经》中的传承，正如利奥三世可以在
《法律选编》
的序言中，把主教的权威赋予皇帝。
在七世纪的情势下，自希拉克略起，这些称号有了新的意涵。五六会议教规与
《法律选编》
的用语及口吻也显示，宫廷及帝国典礼的礼仪化已经发展到相当程度，而在这个基础上，七世纪后期罗马
politeia
（国家）本身又在不止一种意义上经历了神圣化。
The full implications and impact of the Christianization of the imperial cult— completed in the course of the fifth century— had taken many decades to become apparent.

From the beginning it was widely accepted that the emperor was representative of both the secular as well as the spiritual authority. A law of Valentinian II of the year 384 illustrates the tendency: “There must be no dispute concerning an imperial judgement, for it is a kind of sacrilege to doubt whether the person whom the Emperor has selected is worthy.” The harmonization of the two forms of authority was at the heart of the imperial position as summed up in Justinian’s novel 6, issued in 535, even if there remained a tension and debate around this theme and in particular around the role of the emperor in formulating dogma.

Focused primarily on the imperial court and the position of the ruler, the process was marked at progressive stages by the legislation and ecclesiastical politics of Justinian and his successors as well as by the liturgification of court and palatine ceremonial already noted and now reasonably well understood.

From the fourth to the seventh century and beyond, the acclamation of emperors as “new Constantine” and “new Justinian” recalled this, and “new Solomon” or “new David” evoked the biblical heritage of the Christian Roman emperor, just as in the preface to the
Ecloga
Leo III could attribute the authority of a bishop to the emperors.
In the context of the seventh century, from Heraclius onward, these epithets received a new valency. And the language and tone of the canons of the Quinisext council, on the one hand, and of the
Ecloga
, on the other, suggest that, in more than one sense, the late seventh century saw, beyond the already well-advanced liturgification of the court and imperial ceremonial, a sacralization of the Roman
politeia
(state) itself.
新的边界，新的分野
New Boundaries, New Divisions

第一阶段的阿拉伯征服过后，基督徒共同体的分裂已经不只出于基督论和三位一体的本性等问题。仍受罗马帝国统治的地区与帝国之外的地区之间，如今又产生了政治与地理的分野。无论政治形势如何，皇帝都继续声称拥有普世主权，如前所述，许多人也认为帝国最终会收复失地。不过，罗马国家和基督徒共同体的范围显然已经不再重合。这就引出了一个问题：在这个分离的过程中，在帝国留下的土地上，在多大程度上形成了一种特属于罗马、帝国和基督教的认同，把“罗马人”，即蒙上帝护佑、爱基督的唯一皇帝的臣民，同先前属帝国领土的其余基督徒区分开来？尤其考虑到后者此后有一段时间仍自认为“罗马人”，问题就更值得追问。这种认同在多大程度上为不同社会经济群体所共有？小亚细亚居民对征服与占领的抵抗，至少表面看来格外顽强，这种认同在其中又起了多大作用？

After the initial phase of Arab conquests, the Christian community was divided by more than just matters of Christology and the nature of the Trinity, for there now evolved a political and geographical divide between those areas still under Roman imperial governance and those outside. The emperors continued to claim universal sovereignty, regardless of the political situation and, as just noted, many assumed that the empire would eventually recover its lost territories. But the Roman state was very clearly no longer coterminous with the Christian community. And so the question arises, to what extent did a specifically Roman, imperial, Christian identity evolve in the course of this separation and within the territories remaining to the empire, an identity that differentiated “Romans,” the subjects of the one God-protected and Christ-loving emperor, from the rest of the Christian population of formerly imperial lands— particularly in light of the fact that the latter continued to consider themselves “Roman” for a period thereafter? To what extent was such an identity shared across socioeconomic boundaries? And to what extent did it contribute to what appears, at least on the face of things, to have been the peculiarly stubborn resistance to conquest and occupation on the part of the populations of Asia Minor?
牧首尼基弗鲁斯和修士兼编年史家狄奥凡尼斯，分别于八世纪后期和九世纪初写作，两人都理所当然地认为，罗马人是基督徒，基督徒也是罗马人。事实上，
《法律选编》
始终称皇帝的臣民为基督徒，称他们为罗马人已经没有必要，两者在正式表述上完全等同。

此事似乎从来不成问题，只有少数人在七世纪中叶极为特殊的情势下，曾短暂挑战过这一观念。但还有其他因素促成了两者的对应。首先，帝国保有的领土和人口，与被征服的行省之间，无论地理上还是思想上，都变得越来越疏远。帝国与哈里发国之间的跨境往来似乎日益减少，且如第二章所见，受许多限制。在和平时期，朝圣者，以及更重要的教士和修道士，似乎仍可往来于两国之间，但也有一些约束，稍后就会谈到。自650年代以降，战争连绵，边境地带许多地方秩序荡然无存，经常往来便成了一件极其艰难而危险的事。

Both the patriarch Nicephorus and the chronographer and monk Theophanes, writing in the late eighth and early ninth centuries, respectively, took it for granted that Romans were Christians and that Christians were Romans. Indeed, in the
Ecloga
the subjects of the emperor are described throughout as Christians rather than Romans— the formal identity of the two is complete.

This does not seem ever to have been an issue, except for those who, briefly in the middle decades of the seventh century and under very particular circumstances, had challenged the notion. But additional factors played a role that contributed to this parallelism. First, it is worth pointing to the increasing degree of estrangement, geographically as well as ideologically, between the surviving imperial territories and their populations and the conquered provinces. Movement across the frontier between the empire and the caliphate appears to have become ever more limited and, as we have seen in Chapter 2, was subject to many constraints. While the movement of both pilgrims and, more importantly, clergy and monks between the two realms appears to have been possible (but with some limitations, as we shall see in a moment) during periods of peace, the ongoing warfare and the lawless conditions of much of the frontier zone during the decades from the 650s meant that regular traffic was exceedingly difficult and hazardous.
例如657至662年，或678至691年，有人往来于君士坦丁堡与耶路撒冷或亚历山大里亚之间的迹象。这两个时期，帝国都与哈里发国订有正式和约或停战协定。
在哈里发奥斯曼遇刺之后的第一个时期，有史料证明，帝国与巴勒斯坦、叙利亚或埃及的修道团体或教会仍有联系。第二个时期则始于阿拉伯人连遭挫败后于678年议和。东方教士出席了680—681年会议，也出席了691—692年五六会议，不过两次人数都很少。
同样，关于帝国事务的消息显然只能极其缓慢地传到叙利亚，因此例如西奈的阿纳斯塔修斯，对帝国政治事件所知仅是些讹误甚多的消息。
总体看来，自650年代起，拜占庭世界与叙利亚及原属帝国的东部行省之间，来往日益稀少。无疑，商人和偶尔前来的朝圣者等旅人，以及熟知边境一带哪些路风险最低的人，还在朝这个或那个方向行旅。然而证据表明，东罗马与哈里发国这两个世界的关系确在逐渐疏远。
如我在导言中所说，在伊斯兰军队最初征服叙利亚之后不到六十年，为克里特的安德烈撰写
《传记》
的东罗马圣徒传作者，已经能把巴勒斯坦和大叙利亚称作“我们敌人的土地”。

There are indications of travel between Constantinople and Jerusalem or Alexandria in the period 657 to 662, for example, or between 678 and 691, both periods during which the empire had concluded a formal peace or truce with the caliphate.

Contacts between the empire and monastic communities or the church in Palestine and Syria or in Egypt are attested in the first period, which followed the assassination of the caliph ʿUthmān; the second period following the peace concluded in 678 after a series of Arab defeats. Eastern clergy were present at the council of 680–681 as well as at the Quinisext in 691–692, although in both cases the numbers were small.

By the same token, it seems clear that information about affairs in the empire filtered only very slowly to Syria, so that Anastasius of Sinai, for example, had only the most garbled information about political events there.

In general, it seems that from the 650s onward, contacts between the Byzantine world and Syria and the former eastern provinces became fewer and fewer. No doubt some travelers— merchants and the occasional pilgrim, along with those who knew the least dangerous tracks across the frontier region— continued to journey in one direction or the other. But the evidence suggests that a real estrangement was growing up between the two worlds of east Rome and the caliphate.
As I noted in the Introduction, within sixty years of the first Islamic conquests in Syria, the east Roman hagiographer who wrote the
Life
of Andrew of Crete could refer to Palestine and Greater Syria as “the land of our enemies.”
拜占庭政府有意采取的措施，无疑加深了这种疏远，哈里发国采取的措施可能也是如此。帝国控制着通往叙利亚的几条要道，安纳托利亚与北叙利亚之间的往来变慢，很可能部分出于这个缘故。帝国派官员把守出入通道，也是由来已久的做法。

如前所见，主要的过境点都受到严密监视。在原本两边都有基督徒共同体居住的地方，日益确立的边界无助于促进共同的政治认同。有相当可靠的证据表明，自640年代初起，帝国政府开始设防并控制从北叙利亚和美索不达米亚进入安纳托利亚的山口。这条边境线很长，守卫不易，尤其是较难防守的东段。阿拉伯史学传统虽有诸多问题，与叙利亚文史料传统合看，也有足够迹象表明，希拉克略在位的最后几年开始实行一项政策，摧毁一些边境地区，防守穿过托罗斯山脉进入小亚细亚的主要通道。自那时起，直到七世纪末、八世纪头十年，罗马人还能守住托罗斯山与反托罗斯山南麓及东南麓的一些前哨，也守住了奇里乞亚平原的前哨。这些措施有多大成效，后文某章还会谈到。但从此以后，阿拉伯伊斯兰军队征服北叙利亚及南安纳托利亚的步伐确实大为放慢，行动从征服和兼并转为劫掠和扰乱经济、政治。
不论具体情形如何，北叙利亚和安纳托利亚之间显然正在形成一道几百年来未有的“边疆”。然而，毫无疑问，这道边疆多年来依旧很容易穿越，尤其在北叙利亚和安纳托利亚西南部的沿海地带。战事和政治形势彼此消长，许多共同体很可能时常发现，自己时而落在这道假想“边界”的一侧，时而落到另一侧。

Such an estrangement was undoubtedly reinforced by the deliberate actions of the Byzantine government, and possibly that of the caliphate as well. It is highly likely that imperial control over several key routes into Syria was in part responsible for the slowing down of communications between Anatolia and North Syria, and it had long been the practice for imperial officials to be posted to control access to and egress from the empire.

As we have already seen, careful watch was kept on key points of transit, and the consolidation of a frontier or border that stretched across lands that were occupied by Christian communities on both sides cannot have done much to promote a shared political identity. There is reasonably good evidence that from the early 640s the imperial government began a policy of fortifying and controlling access to the passes from North Syria and Mesopotamia into Anatolia. It is a long and difficult frontier, especially in its less readily defended eastern section, but there are enough indications in the problematic Arabic historiographical tradition and in the Syriac tradition to suggest that Heraclius, in his final years, had inaugurated a policy of devastating some border regions and of defending key routes through the Taurus Mountains into Asia Minor. From then through the remaining years of the seventh and into the first decade of the eighth century the Romans were able to hold onto outposts along the southern and southeastern flanks of the Taurus-Anti-Taurus range as well as in the Cilician plain. How effective these measures were we shall see in a subsequent chapter, but it is the case that the pace of Arab-Islamic conquest in North Syria and southern Anatolia slows down dramatically from this point, developing from conquest and absorption to raiding and economic-political disruption.

Whatever the details, it is clear that for the first time in many centuries a “frontier” was evolving between North Syria and Anatolia where there had been no frontier before. Yet there is little doubt that it remained for many years a highly permeable borderland; especially along the coastal regions in both North Syria and southwest Anatolia, it is likely that many communities frequently found themselves on different sides of a notional “frontier” from time to time as the fortunes of warfare and politics fluctuated to and fro.
第二个重要特点，是人们对入侵者的态度，神学著作和通俗文献都对此有所反映。如我在导言中所说，到了七世纪后半叶，东罗马（拜占庭）及基督徒对伊斯兰教在神学上与基督教有重大差异的认识，才刚刚开始形成。即使有人提到伊斯兰教，也通常把它视为一种离经叛道的异端。
西奈的阿纳斯塔修斯是最早在这方面明确提及伊斯兰教义的作者，见其
Hodēgos
，又称
Viae dux
。此书写于680年之前，约于686—689年修订。他在书中表达的看法，同大马士革的约翰在730年代至750年代的说法一样，往往对伊斯兰教义和实践作了较为粗略的概括。

事实上，从萨拉森人开始征服时起，整个东部帝国对他们的主要看法，与其说着眼于他们信什么，不如说着眼于他们是来自沙漠的蛮族。在人们眼里，他们要么不信上帝、毫无虔敬，要么憎恨上帝，敌视基督教及其教堂与实践。他们摧毁自己憎恨或不理解的东西，蔑视基督徒的价值观，因而蔑视一切文明的文化形式。不过，意识到敌人在思想与宗教上的敌意，确实加强了一种观念，即罗马帝国特别以其基督教信仰为标志。正如我们所见，这种观念的传播远远超出了首都和行省的精英阶层。

A second important feature lies in attitudes to the invaders, as reflected in a range of texts, both theological and popular. As I noted in the Introduction, eastern Roman/Byzantine and Christian awareness of Islam as something substantially theologically different from Christian ity had barely begun to evolve by the later seventh century. Islam was generally viewed as a deviant heresy, when it was mentioned at all.
Anastasius of Sinai is the first writer who, in his
Hodēgos
or
Viae dux,

makes an explicit reference to Islamic teaching in this respect. Written before 680 and revised in about 686–689, the ideas he expresses in this text, as those of John of Damascus in the 730s to 750s, are often relatively crude characterizations of Islamic teaching and practice.

Indeed, the dominant perception of the Saracens from the very beginning of their conquests, across the whole of the eastern empire, had less to do with their beliefs than with the fact that they were a barbarous people of the desert, either godless and impious or God-hating and hostile to Christianity, its churches, and its practices, destroying what they hated or did not understand, contemptuous of Christian values and thus of all forms of civilized culture. Yet awareness of the ideological-religious hostility of their enemy certainly helped to consolidate the notion that the Roman Empire was distinguished in particular by its Christian faith, a message that, as we have seen, permeated well beyond the metropolitan and provincial elites.
八世纪乃至九世纪，人们的亲身经历逐渐改变了这类看法，外交使节和去过伊斯兰地区的人尤其如此。不过，这种看法始终出现在这一时期及很久以后论及阿拉伯人及其入侵的拜占庭文献中。它把“萨拉森人”描绘成一种漫画式的形象，同时把他们变成了极端的“他者”，威胁着基督徒社会、基督徒的
mores
（风俗），以及上帝所选中的罗马帝国。

Such views were slowly modified by experience over the course of the eighth and into the ninth century, especially among diplomats and those who traveled in Islamic lands. But it is a constant of all Byzantine texts that deal with the Arabs and the invasions across this period and well beyond, and it served both to caricature the “Saracens” and to turn them into the ultimate “Other” that threatened both Christian society and
mores
as well as God’s chosen empire, that of the Romans.
这一点大可不必详证，但仍值得提及，因为人们在设想当时人如何面对萨拉森人的挑战时，常常忘记这个因素。另一方面，还要看伊斯兰当局如何对待它不得不打交道的各个基督徒共同体。至少到九世纪初，基督徒仍占大叙利亚人口的绝大多数。基督徒中尤其是麦尔基派，即恪守卡尔西顿信仰、因而会被视为忠于东罗马皇帝（罗马人的“王”，
malik

）的人，有时显然受到怀疑，由此可能遭到迫害、骚扰或监视。在伊斯兰纪元的第一个世纪里，伊斯兰当局对征服地区的统治较不稳固，帝国海军和陆军又是明显的威胁，个人或群体偶尔还投向罗马一方。在这种形势下，颇多基督徒先后被疑为间谍而遭杀害。正如已有学者指出的，当时某些最重要的新殉道者，例如725年的耶路撒冷六十殉道者，以及许多其他人，似乎正属此类。有人也据此提出，在与罗马帝国持续冲突的情况下，伊斯兰当局对基督徒的怀疑，是颁行歧视基督徒的法律的原因之一。
皇帝治下和哈里发治下的地区必定有着明显的反差，这不能不强化人们对两地政治和文化差异日益增长的认识。

While this hardly needs to be demonstrated in detail, it is worth mentioning here because it is often forgotten as a factor in determining how we might imagine people of the time responding to the Saracen challenge. The reverse of the medal lies in the attitude of the Islamic authorities to the different Christian communities with which they had to deal, and who until at least the early ninth century constituted by far the majority population of the greater Syrian region. Christians, and more importantly Melkite Christians— those who adhered to their Chalcedonian faith and could thus be seen as loyal to the eastern Roman emperor, the “king”
(malik)

of the Romans— were clearly suspect on occasion and thus liable to persecution, harassment, or surveillance. In the context of the relatively fragile nature of Islamic rule in the conquered lands during the first Islamic century, of the obvious threat posed by imperial naval as well as land forces, and of the occasional desertion to the Romans of individuals as well as groups, a good number of Christians were killed on suspicion of being spies at various times. Some of the most important Christian neomartyrs of the period appear to belong to this category, as has been pointed out: the sixty martyrs of Jerusalem (in 725), for example, and many others. By the same token, Islamic suspicion about Christians in respect of the ongoing conflict with the Roman Empire has also been suggested as one reason underlying the promulgation of anti-Christian discriminatory laws.

The contrast between those lands under the emperor’s rule and those under that of the caliph must have been very clear and can hardly have done other than to reinforce a growing perception of political and cultural difference.

A Common Cause?

那么，这种基督徒罗马人认同在多大程度上促成或支持了东罗马帝国全体人口对共同利益的认识？在七世纪后半叶和八世纪初抵御敌袭与阿拉伯伊斯兰军队的入侵时，这种认识是否发挥了作用？考古与历史证据一致表明，虽然攻击频繁，城市有时还遭到劫掠，但一般说来，居民要么抵抗，要么找地方暂避，等敌人离开再回到聚落。最好的文献记录出自归于“新兵”圣狄奥多尔的奇迹集，与赫勒诺本都（小亚细亚中北部）的欧凯塔城有关。作者详细记述了敌人“每年的袭掠”到来时，居民如何撤到城后的设防卫城，等敌人带着掠获物离开之后再返回。
虽然没有具体的文献记载，许多其他聚落显然也是如此。有时，尤其在长期最容易遭到劫掠和攻击的地区，居民最终放弃了原有聚落。711年，地处奇里乞亚平原、屡遭攻击的西锡翁居民终于决定弃城北迁，进入托罗斯山区，离开无险可守的低地。
然而，这些行为是否可以称为抵抗，抵抗究竟具有怎样的性质，又是在什么时候、出于什么原因发生或没有发生，仍无答案。

To what extent, therefore, did this Christian Roman identity generate or support an awareness of common interests across the whole population of the Eastern Roman Empire, and did this help in the defense against hostile attacks and the invasions of the Arab-Islamic armies in the second half of the seventh and the first part of the eighth century? The archaeological and historical evidence coincides in showing that, in spite of frequent attacks and sometimes the sack of a city, the population generally resisted or took refuge somewhere until the enemy had gone before reoccupying their settlement. The best textual account comes from a collection of miracles ascribed to St. Theodore “the recruit” and associated with the town of Euchaïta in Helenopontus (north central Asia Minor). Here the author describes in detail how the population took to their fortified acropolis behind the town during “the yearly raid” of the enemy before returning when the enemy had departed with its booty.

But although we have no specific texts for them, the same was clearly the case for many other settlements. And sometimes, especially in those areas most exposed to constant raiding and attack, the settlements were ultimately abandoned. In 711 the inhabitants of the town of Sision, in the Cilician plain and the subject of continuing attacks, finally decided to abandon their city and relocate northward, into the Taurus region and away from the exposed lowlands.
The question as to the nature of resistance to invaders (if that is what it was) as well as when and why it took place or did not take place, however, remains as yet unanswered.
要理解这个问题所处的背景，不妨在留意导言所述一般政治史背景的同时，简要回顾这一时期阿拉伯军队进攻的经过，找出几个重要特征。
首先，学界一般认同，阿拉伯军队自640年代起开始攻打东罗马帝国，在穆阿维叶领导下（他先任叙利亚总督，自660年起为哈里发）行动越来越快也越来越猛烈，明确以征服和消灭东罗马帝国为目标。拜占庭人成了伊斯兰世界的主要对手，此后两个多世纪一直如此。他们不仅构成军事挑战，也构成根本的意识形态挑战。

不过，进攻的重心似乎有过明显变化，先是在660年代初，后来又在680年穆阿维叶去世、其子叶齐德一世继任哈里发之后。640年代后期和650年代，阿拉伯军队已对安纳托利亚发动大规模袭扰；自660年代初至679年，袭扰年年发生，有时一年两三次。阿拉伯部队劫掠了与伊斯兰势力已经牢牢控制的领土接壤的要塞和居民点，另一些部队则深入安纳托利亚各行省。663至679年间几乎每年都有一支或多支阿拉伯军队在拜占庭领土上过冬。他们就地取给，掳掠俘虏、牲畜等战利品。成千上万的人被掳走，送到叙利亚为奴。受打击最严重的地区，其基础设施必定遭到严重破坏，我会在后面一章举一个具体例子。袭击的目标遍及整个安纳托利亚腹地，看来是要先“削弱”抵抗，以逐渐耗损帝国、切断往来并瓦解组织上的联系，促成如同在叙利亚和埃及所发生的那种政治与军事崩溃。阿拉伯人攻到了特拉比松和安卡拉这般偏远的城市（两城均在654年遭袭），也到达欧凯塔（可能早在641年，660年代肯定不止一次）。更常遭到袭击的，是科洛尼亚、阿莫里翁、皮西迪亚的安条克、奇里乞亚的塔尔索斯和莫普苏埃斯蒂亚等要塞城镇，以及吕基亚、伊苏里亚、弗里吉亚、卡帕多西亚和第四亚美尼亚各行省的其他要塞与居民点。其中不少城市或城镇被攻陷并遭劫掠，但几乎立刻被夺回、重新有人居住。因此，阿拉伯军队很少能据守重要的设防中心超过一冬，无论哪一次，占领时间都不超过几个月。654—655年，君士坦丁堡本身也成了一次大规模进攻的目标；然而主力舰队毁于风暴，进攻尚未开始便已瓦解。随行陆军随后在穿越安纳托利亚途中也被击败。

To understand the context within which we can address this issue, it is worth briefly reviewing the course of the Arab attacks across this period in order to highlight some important features, bearing in mind the general political historical background as outlined in the introductory chapter.

First, there is general agreement that, commencing in the 640s and gathering in both pace and intensity under Muʿāwiya (first as governor of Syria, then as caliph from 660), the attack on the Eastern Roman Empire was explicitly aimed at its conquest and eradication. The Byzantines became— and remained for more than two centuries thereafter— the main opponent of Islam, posing both a military as well as a fundamental ideological challenge.

But it seems that there were significant shifts in emphases, first in the early 660s and again after the year 680, the year in which Muʿāwiya died and his son Yazīd I succeeded to the caliphate. Across the later 640s and 650s substantial raids were mounted into Anatolia, but from the early 660s until 679 they became yearly, sometimes two or even three times in a single year. Fortresses and settlements in the zones immediately adjacent to territories firmly under Islamic rule were raided, other columns pushed deep into the provinces of Anatolia, and virtually every year between 663 and 679 one or more Arab armies also wintered on Byzantine territory. These armies lived off the land and raided for captives, livestock, and other forms of booty. Thousands of prisoners were taken and carried off to Syria to be enslaved. The infrastructural damage to the hardest hit areas must have been substantial, and I will give a specific example in a later chapter. The targets of these attacks ranged across the whole of the Anatolian hinterland, aimed apparently at a “softening up” of resistance as part of a plan to wear the empire down, disrupt communications and organizational cohesion, and, as in Syria and Egypt, encourage a political and military collapse. They reached cities as far afield as Trebizond (in 654), Ankara (also in 654), and Euchaïta (possibly in 641, certainly in the 660s on more than one occasion). More regularly, fortress towns such as Koloneia, Amorium, Antioch in Pisidia, Tarsus, and Mopsuestia in Cilicia, and other fortresses and settlements in the provinces of Lycia, Isauria, Phrygia, Cappadocia, and Armenia IV were targeted. Although many of these cities or towns were taken and sacked, they were almost immediately retaken and reoccupied so that Arab forces rarely succeeded in maintaining a hold over a key fortified center for more than one winter season, never for more than a few months at any time. And Constantinople itself was the target of a major assault in 654–655, although the assault was defeated before it began when the main fleet was destroyed in a storm, and the accompanying land forces were defeated as they marched through Anatolia shortly thereafter.

第一次阿拉伯内战于656年爆发，持续到661年，使连绵的进攻暂时中断。君士坦斯因此能重新考虑帝国战略，尤其能经巴尔干进军意大利，加强帝国在西方的利益。然而从663年起，穆阿维叶开始了一项更有计划的战略。他既要消耗对手的抵抗力量和士气、打断行政运作，也要摧毁安纳托利亚各地的经济，粉碎抵抗的意志。668—669年的围攻标志着阿拉伯人扩张企图的一个高点，但其攻势仍不间断地逐年持续。直到穆阿维叶在680年去世，战略才发生变化，越冬的袭扰几乎完全停止。例如从叶齐德一世于680年即位至717年，有记载的只有两次。

The first Arab civil war that broke out in 656 and lasted until 661 meant a pause in the continuous nature of the assault and permitted Constans to rethink imperial strategy and in particular permitted his march through the Balkans to Italy in order to reinforce imperial interests in the west. But from 663 a more deliberate strategy was begun by Muʿāwiya aimed not only at wearing down opposition and morale and disrupting administrative continuity but also at destroying local economies throughout Anatolia, crushing the will to resist. The siege of 668–669 marks a high point in terms of Arab ambitions, but the yearly attacks continued uninterrupted. Only with Muʿāwiya’s death in 680 did the strategy change and the overwintering raids ceased almost completely (only two are recorded between the accession of Yazīid I in 680 and the year 717, for example).
对拜占庭而言，一个关键因素是哈里发国内部的争斗，即通常说的第一次与第二次
fitna
（内战）。第一次内战期间，哈里发奥斯曼于656年遇刺，穆阿维叶于661年最终获胜。在第二次内战中，叶齐德一世（680—683年在位）、穆阿维叶二世（683—684年在位）、马尔万一世（684—685年在位）相继即位、去世，之后阿卜杜勒·马利克即位（685—705年在位）。他在位时，争斗虽未终止，至少有所平息，形成了更强大、在行政上也有所革新的政权。

此处有两个重要因素。首先，东罗马皇帝能够利用这些困难，达成对帝国极为有利的停战协定。第一次内战期间，君士坦斯二世得以在高加索作战并加强当地的帝国权威，此后才把注意力转向西方。678—679年，谈判已由穆阿维叶和皇帝君士坦丁四世推动展开。前者当时正努力应对反对其子叶齐德继承哈里发之位的人，后者则准备应付新近到达多瑙河的保加尔人，还要筹备第六次普世教会会议并同教廷谈判。单是为了巩固边防、使各行省免受持续劫掠，拜占庭一方当然就非常想议和。最初的停战似乎迟迟没有实行（据报，在本应已经停战之后，阿拉伯人的袭扰仍未停止）。
哈里发国的内乱持续了一段时间，帝国因而得以在685年以更有利的条件缔结第二项和约，并在688—689年予以确认。当时阿卜杜勒·马利克正竭力使伊拉克和汉志的反对者服从他的权威，东罗马统治者则在奇里乞亚发起了进攻。
A crucial factor for Byzantium were the internecine conflicts within the caliphate, known collectively as the first and second
fitna,

or civil wars, conflicts that saw the assassination of the caliph ʿUthmān in 656 and the final victory of Muʿāwiya in 661; and the accession and demise of Yazīd I (680–683), Muʿāwiya II (683–684) and Marwān I (684–685) before the accession of ʿAbd al-Malik (685–705), whose caliphate saw, if not an end, then a dampening down of the strife and witnessed the rise of a stronger and administratively innovative regime.

Two elements were important here. First, the emperors of east Rome were able to take advantage of these problems to achieve truces highly advantageous to the empire. During the first civil war Constans II had been able to campaign in the Caucasus and reinforce imperial authority there before turning his attention westward. In 678–679 negotiations had already begun, promoted by Muʿāwiya (as he attempted to deal with opposition to his wish to secure the succession to the caliphate for his son Yazīd) and by the emperor Constantine IV (as he prepared to deal with the newly arrived Bulgars on the Danube, the preparations for the sixth ecumenical council, and negotiations with the papacy). A peace was of course highly desirable on the Byzantine side in any case, simply to permit the consolidation of frontier defenses and to free the provinces from the constant raiding. While the initial truce seems to have been slow in starting (Arab raids are reported after it had supposedly begun),

the internal troubles of the caliphate continued for some time, permitting a second peace treaty to be agreed on even more favorable terms for the imperial side in 685 and confirmed in 688–689 as ʿAbd al-Malik struggled to impose his authority over oppositional forces in Iraq and the Hejaz, and as the east Roman ruler went onto the offensive in Cilicia.
其次，692年最终击败“内部”敌人之后，阿卜杜勒·马利克得以把注意力转向行政、财政，以及对伊斯兰教在西方的主要敌人东罗马国家的持续斗争。拜占庭势力在亚美尼亚和伊比利亚的存在既然源于688—689年的和约，大概并不是战事的直接起因。不过，阿卜杜勒·马利克应以何种金币交付贡金，引发了争执，拜占庭也可能要求取得塞浦路斯的全部收入（按685年和约，收入应由双方分取）。这些紧张关系导致战端重启。

693年，帝国军队在塞巴斯托波利斯附近战败后，阿拉伯人再度进攻，但战略同穆阿维叶所推动的大不相同。从此时起直到720年代，进攻重心放在围绕安纳托利亚帝国腹地的“边境”地区，从第四亚美尼亚及其东南诸地，绕到奇里乞亚平原和伊苏里亚，不过有时袭击也深入得多，北达阿马塞亚，中至多里莱翁。此前，拜占庭人曾守住这一带的几座重要要塞，即卡马哈、狄奥多西奥波利斯、梅利泰内以西的塔兰通、奇里乞亚山门以北的提亚纳，以及一串较小的设防据点，其名称很少见于史料。事实上，688—689年之后的和平，几乎必然让帝国军队得以整顿并加强边防。

Second, with the final defeat of his “internal” enemies in 692, ʿAbd al-Malik could turn his attention to matters of administration and finance and to the ongoing struggle against the major enemy of Islam in the west, the eastern Roman state. While the Byzantine presence in Armenia and Iberia was probably not the immediate cause of hostilities, following on as it did from the treaty of 688–689, tensions over the form in which ʿAbd al-Malik’s payment of the tribute in gold coin and a possible Byzantine claim to all the revenues of Cyprus (divided between the two parties according to the treaty of 685) led to a renewed outbreak of hostilities.

Following the defeat of imperial forces near Sebastopolis in 693 the Arab offensive was renewed, yet the strategy was markedly different from the one Muʿāwiya had promoted. From this point and into the 720s, the focus is on the “frontier” regions ringing the imperial heartland in Anatolia, from Armenia IV and the regions to south and east around into the Cilician plain and into Isauria, although on occasion raids penetrated more deeply, as far as Amaseia in the north and Dorylaion in the center. Hitherto the Byzantines had been able to hold onto several key fortresses in these regions— Kamacha, Theodosiopolis, Taranton west of Melitene, and Tyana north of the Cilician Gates as well as a string of much smaller fortified strongholds whose names are only rarely noted in the sources. Indeed, the peace of the years after 688–689 had almost certainly permitted the imperial forces to reform and strengthen the frontier defenses.
然而自690年代后期起，情势开始改变。阿拉伯战略转而集中摧毁这些工事，铲除任何有组织的边防。拜占庭人已经撤出奇里乞亚平原，但阿拉伯兵力一到那里，拜占庭人仍常发起攻击。现在，阿拉伯人第一次实际占据了这片平原。703年，他们重建、加固莫普苏埃斯蒂亚并在此驻军，很大程度上因为它可以作为更重要的安条克城的前沿防御。
莫普苏埃斯蒂亚东北的西锡翁，其居民和驻军最终在711年撤离。

715—716年，后来导致717—718年君士坦丁堡第二次遭围的一系列战役已经展开。此时奇里乞亚全境落入阿拉伯人手里，拜占庭人被逼退到托罗斯山和反托罗斯山防线，在东线失去卡马哈（原文此处作 Kamachon）、狄奥多西奥波利斯和亚美尼亚，只能极为艰难地防守奇里乞亚山门和通向卡帕多西亚与伊苏里亚的其他山口。综观阿拉伯人的进攻方式，显然可以看出战略已经改变，新的主要目标是逐渐削弱拜占庭的防御。也许从一开始就是为715—717年的大规模战役作准备，但更可能的情况是，穆阿维叶的战略没能迫使帝国，尤其是各行省的居民直接屈服，阿拉伯人起初是因此才转变了战略。对君士坦丁堡的进攻，当然又一次意在给帝国以决定性的一击，这一次是通过先摧毁帝国保卫都城的能力来准备进攻。虽然围攻最终失败，阿拉伯人仍在720年代、730年代乃至740年代发动袭扰和大规模远征，拜占庭人抵抗的力度以及迎战、击败入侵者的意愿却有所增强。阿拉伯伊斯兰军队的战略目标有了改变。摧毁或使罗马国家臣服仍是长期目标，而扩张性的征服让位于长期消耗战。深入小亚细亚的袭扰仍在继续，却不那么经常，主要拜占庭城市被攻陷、洗劫的事也较少（例如723年的伊科尼翁、726年卡帕多西亚的凯撒里亚）。
边境地带仍是主要目标，战事变得有了常规，帝国军队能够相当有效地应对，使内陆地区得以逐渐恢复。正如已有研究指出的，这时战争主要采取小规模袭扰的形式，尤其是
sa’ifa
（夏季袭扰）。

But from the late 690s, this began to change as the Arab strategy concentrated on the destruction of these installations and the eradication of any organized frontier. The Cilician plain, abandoned by the Byzantines but regularly attacked when Arab forces were there, was now for the first time occupied—in 703 Mopsuestia was rebuilt, fortified, and garrisoned in large part because it served as an advanced defense for the more important city of Antioch;
Sision, to the northeast of Mopsuestia, was finally abandoned by its population and garrison in 711;

by the time the series of campaigns that culminated in the second siege of Constantinople in 717–718 was under way (715–716), Cilicia was entirely in Arab hands and the Byzantines were forced back on the Taurus-Anti-Taurus line, losing Kamachon, Theodosiopolis, and Armenia on the eastern front and defending the Cilician Gates and other passes into Cappadocia and Isauria with the greatest difficulty. Surveys of the pattern of Arab attacks clearly bears out the fact that strategy had shifted, with the main aim now being to grind down Byzantine defenses— whether preparatory to the great campaigns of 715–717 from the beginning or, as seems more likely, initially as a reflection of the failure of Muʿāwiya’s strategy to achieve its end of forcing the empire and more especially its provincial populations simply to give in. The attack on Constantinople was intended again, of course, as a final knock-out blow, this time prepared by the destruction of the imperial capacity for defending the capital. While its ultimate failure did not stop the raiding or mounting of large-scale expeditions through the 720s, 730s, and into the 740s, Byzantine resistance and willingness to confront and defeat the invaders in battle increased. Arab-Islamic strategic objectives changed— while the long-term intention remained the destruction or subjection of the Roman state, expansionist conquest was replaced by a longer-term war of attrition. Raids deep into Asia Minor continued but less regularly, the capture and sack of major Byzantine centers occurred less often (Ikonion in 723, Caesarea in Cappadocia in 726, for example),

the border zones remained the chief target, and the warfare settled down into a routine with which imperial forces were able to deal fairly effectively, permitting the slow recovery of the inland regions. As has been pointed out, the warfare now largely takes the form of small-scale raiding, focusing especially on the
sa’ifa,
or summer raid.
